name: Akashima Junsaku
source: Junsaku is a Mecha pilot who just graduated from the police academy. Due to his excellent grades and his expertise in close combat with Mecha, he was randomly selected by Hikari to transfer to the Aozora Police Station. Others commented that his future was doomed. He was very resistant to being called by his given name (which means KIA).
